::: {.section-lead}
Peer-reviewed articles, chapters, and papers
:::

A current list, including preprints, is available on my
[Google Scholar profile](https://scholar.google.co.za/citations?user=EhrDFkYAAAAJ&hl=en){target="_blank"}.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

## Work in a UTF-8 locale so accented names / dashes read & print correctly
## regardless of the machine running the build.
for (loc in c("en_US.UTF-8", "C.UTF-8", "en_US.utf8", "C.utf8")) {
  if (suppressWarnings(Sys.setlocale("LC_CTYPE", loc)) != "") break
}

## ---- minimal BibTeX reader (base R only) --------------------------------
bib <- readLines("publications.bib", warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8")
starts <- grep("^@", bib)
ends   <- c(starts[-1] - 1, length(bib))
entries <- Map(function(s, e) bib[s:e], starts, ends)

esc <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x)) return(x)
  x <- gsub("&", "&amp;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("<", "&lt;",  x, fixed = TRUE)
  gsub(">", "&gt;",  x, fixed = TRUE)
}
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a) || is.na(a) || !nzchar(a)) b else a

parse_entry <- function(lines) {
  h <- regmatches(lines[1], regexec("^@([a-zA-Z]+)\\{([^,]+),", lines[1]))[[1]]
  rec <- list(type = tolower(h[2]), key = trimws(h[3]))
  for (ln in lines[-1]) {
    m <- regmatches(ln, regexec("^\\s*([a-zA-Z]+)\\s*=\\s*(.*)$", ln))[[1]]
    if (length(m) == 3) {
      v <- trimws(m[3])
      v <- sub(",\\s*$", "", v)                         # trailing comma
      v <- sub("^\\{", "", v); v <- sub("\\}$", "", v)  # wrapping braces
      v <- gsub("[{}]", "", v)                          # case-protection braces
      v <- gsub("\\\\([&%_#$])", "\\1", v)              # unescape LaTeX specials (\& -> &)
      rec[[tolower(m[2])]] <- v
    }
  }
  rec
}
recs <- lapply(entries, parse_entry)

## ---- formatting helpers -------------------------------------------------
fmt_authors <- function(a) {
  if (is.null(a)) return("")
  people <- trimws(strsplit(a, " and ", fixed = TRUE)[[1]])
  one <- function(p) {
    if (tolower(p) == "others") return("et al.")
    if (!grepl(",", p, fixed = TRUE)) return(esc(p))   # consortium / single name
    fam <- trimws(sub(",.*$", "", p))
    giv <- trimws(sub("^[^,]*,", "", p))
    toks <- unlist(strsplit(giv, "[ .]+")); toks <- toks[nzchar(toks)]
    inits <- if (length(toks)) paste0(toupper(substr(toks, 1, 1)), ".", collapse = " ") else ""
    nm <- esc(trimws(paste0(fam, ", ", inits)))
    if (grepl("Parry", fam, fixed = TRUE)) nm <- paste0("<strong>", nm, "</strong>")
    nm
  }
  out <- vapply(people, one, character(1))
  truncated <- FALSE
  if (length(out) > 10) { out <- c(out[1:10], "et al."); truncated <- TRUE }
  n <- length(out)
  if (n == 1) return(out)
  if (truncated || identical(out[n], "et al."))
    return(paste(out, collapse = ", "))
  paste0(paste(out[-n], collapse = ", "), ", &amp; ", out[n])
}

fmt_venue <- function(r) {
  it <- function(x) paste0("<em>", esc(x), "</em>")
  pg <- function(p) esc(gsub("--", "\u2013", p, fixed = TRUE))   # -- -> en dash
  if (!is.null(r$journal)) {                                # anything with a journal
    v <- it(r$journal)
    if (!is.null(r$volume)) v <- paste0(v, ", ", esc(r$volume),
        if (!is.null(r$number)) paste0("(", esc(r$number), ")") else "")
    if (!is.null(r$pages))  v <- paste0(v, ", ", pg(r$pages))
    paste0(v, ".")
  } else if (r$type %in% c("incollection", "inproceedings")) {
    v <- paste0("In ", it(r$booktitle %||% "the proceedings"))
    if (!is.null(r$pages)) v <- paste0(v, " (pp. ", pg(r$pages), ")")
    if (!is.null(r$publisher)) v <- paste0(v, ". ", esc(r$publisher))
    paste0(v, ".")
  } else {
    paste0(esc(r$publisher %||% r$note %||% ""), ".")
  }
}

fmt_links <- function(r) {
  L <- character(0)
  pdf <- file.path("files/papers", paste0(r$key, ".pdf"))
  if (file.exists(pdf))
    L <- c(L, sprintf('<a href="%s" target="_blank">PDF</a>', pdf))
  if (!is.null(r$doi)) {
    doi <- r$doi
    href <- if (grepl("^https?://", doi)) doi else paste0("https://doi.org/", doi)
    L <- c(L, sprintf('<a href="%s" target="_blank">DOI</a>', href))
  } else if (!is.null(r$url)) {
    L <- c(L, sprintf('<a href="%s" target="_blank">Link</a>', r$url))
  }
  paste(L, collapse = "")
}

## ---- assemble & sort by year (desc), no-date last -----------------------
years <- vapply(recs, function(r) {
  y <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(sub(".*?([0-9]{4}).*", "\\1", r$year %||% "")))
  if (is.na(y)) 0L else y
}, integer(1))

for (y in sort(unique(years), decreasing = TRUE)) {
  lbl <- if (y == 0L) "Undated" else as.character(y)
  cat("\n## ", lbl, " {.pub-year}\n\n", sep = "")
  cat("```{=html}\n")                       # raw HTML block: no markdown escaping
  for (r in recs[years == y]) {
    title <- esc(r$title %||% "Untitled")
    if (!grepl("[.?!]$", title)) title <- paste0(title, ".")   # avoid double period
    meta  <- paste0(fmt_authors(r$author), " ", fmt_venue(r))
    links <- fmt_links(r)
    cat('<div class="pub"><span class="pub-title">', title,
        '</span> <span class="pub-meta">', meta, '</span>',
        if (nzchar(links)) paste0(' <span class="pub-links">', links, '</span>') else "",
        "</div>\n", sep = "")
  }
  cat("```\n\n")
}
```
